edges.reason: msg.sender selects the pendingWithdrawals entry that withdraw() pays out.
withdraw() performs a native transfer to the untrusted caller.
The ETH transfer can invoke the caller's fallback, allowing re-entry.
withdraw() reads the caller's pending withdrawal balance.
withdraw() zeroes the pending balance before sending.
The pending amount is used as the value of the transfer.
buyPunk() inspects and clears the punk bid record.
The caller becomes the new punk owner in buyPunk().
buyPunk() credits escrowed proceeds to pendingWithdrawals.
buyPunk() verifies the listed seller against punkIndexToAddress.
buyPunk() reassigns punkIndexToAddress to the buyer.
buyPunk() reads the Offer record, its minValue and onlySellTo.
The caller identity determines the bid refund processed in withdrawBidForPunk().
withdrawBidForPunk() refunds the bidder with a native transfer.
The refund transfer hands control to the caller's fallback function.
withdrawBidForPunk() reads and clears punkBids[punkIndex].
transferPunk() requires the caller to be the current owner.
transferPunk() cancels any active sale listing.
transferPunk() decrements the sender balance without SafeMath.
balanceOf is mutated with unchecked arithmetic operators.
transferPunk() increments the recipient balance with unchecked arithmetic.
transferPunk() revaults a bid held by the new owner.
transferPunk() rewrites punkIndexToAddress for the recipient.
enterBidForPunk() requires an existing owner different from the bidder.
The caller becomes the new highest bidder.
enterBidForPunk() reads the existing bid value and outbids it.
The caller must be the current punk owner accepting a bid.
acceptBidForPunk() reads and clears the bid record.
acceptBidForPunk() escrows the bid value into pendingWithdrawals.
acceptBidForPunk() resets the sale listing after the sale.
initiateUnlock() derives the release time from the block timestamp.
initiateUnlock() writes the computed release time into releaseTimes.
The timelock mapping is the storage target of initiateUnlock().
transferOwnership() is gated on the stored _owner value.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with _owner.
securityLevel selects the delay returned by getDelay().
The nonReentrant modifier reads and writes _status around mintPunk().
The caller must be the seller and receives the minted tokens.
mintPunk() adds the acquired punk to the reserves set.
mintPunk() checks reserve state while processing the deposit.
redeemPunk() reads reserves length and index for selection.
redeemPunk() calls getPseudoRand() to choose the punk index.
The random seed includes the block timestamp.
The random seed includes the caller address.
getPseudoRand() produces the miner-influenceable randomness value.
block.timestamp feeds the weak randomness computation.
msg.sender is hashed into the weak randomness computation.
mintAndRedeem() mutates the reserves set through mint and redeem.
redeemRetroactively() uses getPseudoRand() to pick a reserve.
redeemRetroactively() removes the selected punk from reserves.
redeemRetroactively() inherits timestamp-based randomness selection.
mintRetroactively() adds the excess punk to reserves.
mintRetroactively() invokes the owner-only ERC20 mint.
mintRetroactively() is restricted to the owner caller.
migrate() iterates over the reserves set.
migrate() indexes reserves with the same at()/length path used by randomness selection.
migrate() is gated by onlyOwner and the timelock modifier.
simpleRedeem() reads and removes the first reserve.
simpleRedeem() burns from and transfers to the caller.
simpleRedeem() is wrapped by the nonReentrant guard.
simpleRedeem() requires the paused state via whenPaused.
Verified integrators bypass fees during mintPunk().
burnFees parameters drive the fee arithmetic in redeemPunk().
mintFees parameters drive the fee arithmetic in mintPunk().
dualFees parameters drive the fee arithmetic in mintAndRedeem().
sendValue() performs the low-level value call.
_functionCallWithValue() performs the low-level call with value.
Profitable.withdraw() forwards the whole balance to the destination.
Profitable.withdraw() is protected by onlyOwner.
The owner check compares the caller against _owner.
directRedeem() requires the caller to be a verified controller.
msg.sender is checked against verifiedControllers and emitted as the actor.
directRedeem() verifies and removes the punk from reserves.
XToken.mint() is restricted to the owner caller.
XToken.mint() relies on the stored _owner for authorization.
numControllers tracks the set of authorized controllers used by directRedeem().

normalization_plan.reason: The punkIndex parameter flows directly into CryptoPunksMarket.buyPunk and is merged into it.
The local amount is the value passed to the withdraw transfer unsafe operation.
The tokenId parameter is the sole input consumed by XVault.mintPunk.
The numTokens parameter determines the burn size handled by XVault.redeemPunk.
The recipient parameter only influences CryptoPunksMarket.transferPunk.
The local amount is the value refunded by the withdrawBidForPunk transfer unsafe operation.
The local fee is computed and validated inside XVault.mintPunk.
The minPrice parameter is only compared inside CryptoPunksMarket.acceptBidForPunk.
The recipient parameter is the destination of the Profitable.withdraw sweep.
The recipient parameter is consumed only by XVault.migrate.
